  ∀ t : ℝ, σ < |t| → g t = 0

noncomputable def J_cont (σ : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in Set.Icc (-σ) σ, Complex.abs (f t - g t) ^ 2

noncomputable def J_disc (σ : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  let T : ℝ := 1 / (2 * σ)
  let N : ℤ := Int.floor (σ / T)
  ∑ n in Finset.range (Int.toNat (2 * N + 1)),
    let k : ℤ := (n : ℤ) - N

    Complex.abs (f t - g t) ^ 2

abbrev R3 := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)
def UnitSpeed (γ : ℝ → R3) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, ‖deriv γ t‖ = 1
noncomputable def curvature (γ : ℝ → R3) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ‖deriv (deriv γ) t‖
noncomputable def torsion (γ : ℝ → R3) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let γ₁ : R3 := deriv γ t
  let γ₂ : R3 := deriv (deriv γ) t
  let γ₃ : R3 := deriv (deriv (deriv γ)) t
  let c : R3 := crossProduct γ₁ γ₂
  ⟪c, γ₃⟫_ℝ / (‖c‖ ^ 2)
noncomputable def circularHelix (κ τ : ℝ) : ℝ → R3 :=
  fun t =>
    let ω := Real.sqrt (κ^2 + τ^2)
    let r := κ / (κ^2 + τ^2)
    let c := τ / (κ^2 + τ^2)
    ![
      r * Real.cos (ω * t),
      r * Real.sin (ω * t),
      c * t
    ]

  (κ τ : ℝ)

  | add : LFn 2
  | mul : LFn 2

def L : FirstOrder.Language where

  | ofL : ∀ n, L.Functions n → LcFn n
  | c   : LcFn 0

instance NatLStructure : L.Structure ℕ where
  funMap := by
    intro n f
    cases f with
    | add =>
        intro v
        exact v 0 + v 1
    | mul =>
        intro v
        exact v 0 * v 1
    | z =>
        intro v
        exact 0
    | o =>
        intro v
        exact 1
  RelMap := by
    intro n r
    cases r

instance NatLcStructure (cVal : ℕ) : Lc.Structure ℕ where
  funMap := by
    intro n f
    cases f with
    | ofL n f' =>
        cases f' with
        | add =>

            exact v 0 + v 1
        | mul =>
            intro v
            exact v 0 * v 1
    | z =>
        intro v
        exact 0
    | o =>
        intro v
        exact 1
    | c =>
        intro v
        exact cVal
  RelMap := by
    intro n r
